## 2026-06-09 23:07 PT — Scribe admission control on OT training data reads (IFR)

- **Pattern:** S668542 (Feed Scribe quota exhaustion, 12+ days) invokes ONLINE_TRAINING_SCRIBE_USAGE admission control → throttles IFR model training data reads → `scribe_age_mins CRITICAL` alert fires (N=2)
- **Surface:** `resolved-alerts/2026-06/ALERT-1014037717816039-2026-06-08.md`, `resolved-alerts/2026-06/ALERT-1508512290614499-2026-06-07.md`
- **Root mechanism:** Upstream Scribe quota exhaustion (S668542, >12 days unmitigated, 2.797 TB/s > 2.66 TB/s quota) activates ONLINE_TRAINING_SCRIBE_USAGE admission control on the IFR model's training data intake path (ifr_prospector subsystem); training example age exceeds 10-min threshold; alert auto-clears when quota temporarily eases, then recurs.
- **Detection gap:** P57 covers `scribe_read_proxy.client_lag_in_seconds` false alarms (proxy latency, trainer healthy); P04 covers Scribe QPS spikes. Neither covers ONLINE_TRAINING_SCRIBE_USAGE admission control throttling the data-read path specifically — triage requires checking the admission control resource group, not just scribe_read_proxy or QPS dashboards.
- **Generalization:** When `scribe_age_mins CRITICAL` fires during an active Scribe quota exhaustion SEV: (1) check ONLINE_TRAINING_SCRIBE_USAGE admission control status; (2) expect auto-clear when upstream eases — no OT-side fix; (3) do not create per-model threshold-tune tasks until S668542 or the triggering SEV resolves.

## 2026-06-09 23:07 PT — SPARSE_DELTA alert threshold misfit for QA/low-frequency publish jobs

- **Pattern:** QA/test model with natural publish cadence (~40 min) fires SPARSE_DELTA publishing-gap alert (threshold ~12 min) repeatedly — same model fired twice in 4 days; both self-healed with no model degradation (N=2 across runs)
- **Surface:** `resolved-alerts/2026-06/ALERT-1840391773334834-2026-06-08.md` (this run); prior fire `unknown-2026-06-04-A1840391773334834.md` (prior run)
- **Root mechanism:** Alert threshold (~12 min) calibrated for production models with sub-15-min publish cycles; QA/test jobs (ig_reels_tab_vm_esr 2141728943) run at ~40-min natural cadence — threshold fires on every normal publish gap, not a real failure. Auto-fix task T275008531 filed to raise threshold to ≥40 min.
- **Detection gap:** No P-row for "QA/test/shadow-traffic job with slow natural publish cadence → threshold misfit"; bot spent triage time on both fires before identifying the pattern; threshold-raise task not filed until second fire.
- **Generalization:** For models tagged QA/test/shadow-traffic: (a) check natural publish cadence before filing alert task; (b) threshold should be ≥2× natural cadence + buffer; (c) same model×alert firing within 7 days → escalate as calibration issue, not OT failure; file threshold-tune task on FIRST recurrence, not second.

## 2026-06-09 23:07 PT — MLHub/AIM tooling bug: model_type first-entry instead of model_id lookup

- **Pattern:** MLHub shows wrong MAST job (pni_mb4_fresh) for model 2123804366 (threads_feed_mtml); bot initially mis-classified as MISCONFIG_AGG, corrected to UPSTREAM_INFRA after operator's GraphQL evidence (N=1, single occurrence; novel tooling bug class)
- **Surface:** `resolved-posts/2026-06/2026-06-09-W1346326357462107.md` (authoritative); `resolved-posts/2026-06/POST-1346326357462107-2026-06-08.md` (stale/superseded)
- **Root mechanism:** AIM entity query uses `model_type` as primary key and returns the first matching entry — any model sharing the same type (threads_feed_mtml) returns `pni_mb4_fresh` (earliest in index) instead of the correct OT job for model_id 2123804366. Fix: D107935047 (model_id-based lookup).
- **Detection gap:** Bot initially classified "wrong OT job in display tool" as MISCONFIG_AGG (misconfiguration aggregation); UPSTREAM_INFRA is the correct class — tooling display bugs don't mean OT is misconfigured. Corrected after operator confirmed via GraphQL + accepted answer. Superseded archive filed separately.
- **Generalization:** "MLHub shows wrong OT job for a model" → diagnose via direct GraphQL/`meta ai.model describe` before assuming OT config issue; classify as UPSTREAM_INFRA (tooling bug), not MISCONFIG; operator should escalate to AIM team (not OT oncall) once bot confirms display discrepancy.

## 2026-06-09 23:07 PT — Validator catches per-attempt mis-diagnosis in S673102 (NCCL vs CUDA)

- **Pattern:** S673102 (LSR prod 4366 OT QPS → 0): initial triage mis-diagnosed Attempt 1 failure as CUDA illegal memory access; validator's depth-lens re-read identified NCCL watchdog collective timeout on REDUCE_SCATTER_BASE (3582s). Attempt 0 = Boxcar preemption; Attempt 2 = auto-restart, recovered (N=1 SEV, validator-corrected)
- **Surface:** `resolved-sevs/2026-06/SEV-S673102-2026-06-08.md`
- **Root mechanism:** Multi-attempt MAST failure: Attempt 0 was Boxcar hardware preemption (unrelated); Attempt 1 had NCCL watchdog trip on REDUCE_SCATTER_BASE after 3582s — not a CUDA illegal memory error. MAST auto-restarted on Attempt 2, model recovered to 51.9k samples/30min. No human action needed.
- **Detection gap:** Pattern-matching on multi-attempt log can inherit Attempt 0's classification (Boxcar/hardware) and apply it to Attempt 1's different error; or vice versa. The CUDA vs NCCL distinction requires reading each attempt's error independently. Validator caught this; main triage session did not.
- **Generalization:** Multi-attempt MAST failure: diagnose EACH attempt independently — Attempt 0 and Attempt 1 can have different root causes. Boxcar preemption on Attempt 0 does NOT explain subsequent NCCL timeouts on Attempt 1. NCCL collective timeout on REDUCE_SCATTER_BASE (B-class) is distinct from CUDA illegal memory access — verify the error text verbatim per attempt, not aggregate.

## 2026-06-10 23:00 PT — Scribe infrastructure: two failure modes, two OT impact paths

⚠️ [validator unavailable]

- **Pattern:** Two distinct Scribe failure modes impacted IG OT models in the same week via different paths: (1) Scribe read-proxy quota exhaustion throttled SPARSE_DELTA delivery (trainer alive, alert auto-resolved with upstream S668542/S667358); (2) EAG/DR scribe write-drain caused ~75% DPP ingress drop → all IG Reels OT jobs hung (P16 confirmed, parent S674219, fix D94521578). (N=2, cross-corpus: alert + sev)
- **Surface:** `resolved-alerts/2026-06/ALERT-AGG-2134319967-2026-06-08.md`, `resolved-sevs/2026-06/L2-2026-06-10-S674228.md`
- **Root mechanism:** Scribe infra has two OT-impacting paths: (A) scribe_read_proxy quota exhaustion → SPARSE_DELTA delivery throttled (read-path; P57 covers this; no OT action needed); (B) Scribe write-path drain (EAG/DR region) → DPP scribe-token ingress collapses → OT trainer starved → hang (P16; requires kill/restart + upstream undrain). The two paths are orthogonal — triggering conditions differ, severity differs (A = alert-only; B = OT hang), and mitigations differ (A = wait; B = restart + escalate).
- **Detection gap:** P57 and P16 are separate entries with no cross-reference. When a Scribe SEV is active, the first response should explicitly branch: "read-path impact (P57) or write-path impact (P16)?" — the distinction determines whether restart is needed. Current triage flow doesn't make this branch explicit.
- **Generalization:** When ANY Scribe infra SEV is active: immediately branch on path — check DPP ingress ODS (`fburl.com/canvas/pzoyunzx`) to distinguish read-quota (P57: ingress stable, alert only) vs write-drain (P16: ingress collapsed, trainers hung). Route and restart decisions differ between these two paths; don't conflate Scribe SEV presence with a uniform "MONITOR" verdict.

## 2026-06-11 23:00 PT — P61 zombie trainer: D98638473 fix still not universal 3 weeks after landing

⚠️ [validator unavailable]

- **Pattern:** Two new P61 zombie instances in 7d window: W1347152497379493 (3 root models: 2121054758, 2120474184, 2120929351 on Threads QE) and W1342215704539839 (ig_textpost_feed_u2m_retrieval 2124793203). Both on pre-D98638473 base layer (light_cli versions predating 2026-05-21). D98638473 landed 2026-05-21; zombies still appearing 2026-06-03 and 2026-06-09 (N=2 post archives + same-class SEVs S665454/S670887 in prior weeks)
- **Surface:** `resolved-posts/2026-06/2026-06-09-W1347152497379493.md`, `resolved-posts/2026-06/2026-06-03-W1342215704539839.md`
- **Root mechanism:** CUDACachingAllocator assertion error on one GPU worker → ChildFailedError raised → pre-D98638473 base layer falls through to threading._shutdown() → NCCL communicator threads block in join → MAST never transitions to FAILED despite retries available → zombie. Fix requires each model's OT job to explicitly upgrade its base layer version to ≥2026-05-21 light_cli.
- **Detection gap:** No automated tracking of which OT models are still on pre-D98638473 base layer; each zombie recurrence requires a separate operator intervention (manual kill + notify). No systemic upgrade sweep was triggered when D98638473 landed.
- **Generalization:** When a P-class base-layer fix lands: (a) identify all OT models still running on the affected version via `meta ai.model.instance list` filtered by base_layer_version; (b) auto-file one task per model owner with the upgrade instructions; (c) track upgrade completion rate in fleet-health scan. A fix that lands without a sweep will see recurrences for weeks as models cycle through reruns.

⚠️ [validator unavailable]

- **Pattern:** Two "detector returns absolutely no data" fires in same 24h window: (A) AGG dead detector on ig_reels_tab_cs_omni_retrieval 2122881736 — root S675130 (TKObold global outage, ~51 min, auto-resolved at 10:23 UTC); (B) IFR Watchtower invalid detector on facebook_ifr_main_mtml_main 886797001 — root broken RapidoQuery observer 761497243358527, persists independently of any outage; both present identically as "detector returns absolutely no data" (N=2, `resolved-alerts/2026-06/high-2026-06-12-A846486638144717.md`, `resolved-alerts/2026-06/high-2026-06-12-A860655070440504.md`)
- **Root mechanism:** Dead detector has two structurally different causes: (A) fleet-wide infra outage (TKObold) kills data flow to all detectors simultaneously — alerts cluster across unrelated models, auto-resolve with SEV closure, no OT-side action; (B) observer-specific config failure (stale RapidoQuery data source or misconfigured entity reference) — single model affected, recurring, requires observer config owner to fix. - **Detection gap:** No P-row covers dead detector disambiguation; archive A860655070440504 proposed P54 but P54 is already taken (CDM LATEST_DS_NOT_FOUND). This should be a new P-row (P65 candidate) to close the dead-detector gap.

## 2026-06-11 23:00 PT — Compiler version bump in PACKAGE file can silently block AMD build via -Werror promotion

⚠️ [validator unavailable]

- **Pattern:** SEV-S674096: D107891160 set `llvm-fb=21 / mlir-fb=21` in `fbcode/minimal_viable_ai/fire/PACKAGE`, switching light_cli_amd to clang21; clang21 promoted a FAISS `hipGetLastError` unresolved symbol to -Werror level, blocking the AMD build; entire mrs_ml_release_oncall conveyor blocked with no new releases shipping until fix. - **Surface:** `resolved-sevs/2026-06/SEV-S674096-2026-06-10.md`
- **Root mechanism:** llvm version bump in PACKAGE triggers clang-version-gated -Werror strictness on AMD paths; symbols that previously only warned now fail the build. FAISS `hipGetLastError` was a latent warning; clang21 made it an error. No pre-submit CI check that runs `light_cli_amd` variant build against the FAISS-using code paths.
- **Detection gap:** No CI gate that catches llvm-fb version bumps in PACKAGE files and runs AMD variant builds in response; the regression was caught only after the conveyor blocked. AMD build is a separate variant from x86 and not covered by the standard fbcode CI green path.
- **Generalization:** Any PACKAGE file change that bumps `llvm-fb` or `mlir-fb` should trigger a pre-submit AMD variant build test for all packages in that BUILD target's closure. - **Generalization:** Serving-side metric AGG alerts (CLIPS view-time, potential others) can fire as collateral damage during upstream infra SEVs without any OT training/publish failure. MONITOR pattern applies: confirm OT publish healthy (ITEM_EMB_DELTA/SPARSE_DELTA VALID), confirm active upstream SEV, then classify UPSTREAM_INFRA. Accumulate ≥3 instances for standalone P-row.
